review.why: Turns text into LinkedIn posts using Unicode bold and italic, visual separators and four ready post patterns.
review.summary: Explains that LinkedIn takes plain text only, so styled letters come from Unicode symbols mapped through a character table. It gives four post patterns (hook to call to action, listicle, story to lesson, resource share), formatting rules for hooks, short paragraphs, hashtags and length, and a short process from source text to a copy-paste post.
strengths: Four patterns that can be filled in directly
Hook placed above the see-more cut
A character map reference keeps the conversion accurate
cautions: Does not mention that styled Unicode letters read poorly in screen readers and in text search
LinkedIn reach claims (no links in the body) are heuristics
